sources.title: microduck-arena/docs/guides/challenges/roller-sprint-2m.md at main ...
sources.snippet: Scoring The Arena scans forward commands from 0.30 to 2.00 m/s in 0.10 steps. It tests three shortlisted speeds over five starts and keeps the best average. Each fall or timeout counts as 40 seconds. Aim for five finishes before chasing a faster time.

sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.
